claim_boundary: Quantifies sensitivity to document-grouped upstream role refits and downstream training seeds on FEVER. It does not establish NERC or power-grid-domain accuracy.
primary_estimand: claim-weighted exact sentence-ID macro F1 at label-blind deployment-valid K=3 under predicted roles
primary_variance_question: How much reported C2GES performance and the full-minus-label-blind role contrast vary across independently refitted grouped OOF upstream ledgers and downstream seeds.

analysis.upstream_unit: complete OOF ledger and train-only dev/test role model
analysis.downstream_unit: complete training seed within upstream ledger
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over the frozen primary contrast family

stopping_rule: Run every frozen child exactly once. Stop only on objective integrity or infrastructure failure, retain the incident and partial outputs, and do not substitute seeds or models.
